one_line: HCLTech reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹35,620 crores, up 11.5% YoY, with an EBIT margin of 18.2%.
why: Solid revenue growth, margin expansion, and guidance updates directly impact equity valuation.

promise_links.note: Company revenue growth guidance for FY27 updated to 2.5% - 4.0% in CC.
Services revenue growth guidance for FY27 updated to 3.0% - 4.0% in CC.
EBIT margin reported at 18.2%, within the guided range of 17.5% - 18.5%.
